# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1286
**Entitlement enforcement: cover remaining boundaries (pipeline/capability/API) + action->group mapping (beyond the worker-claim wired by A2)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** A2 (BI-PF-0396) wired entitlement-at-boundary into the WORKER-CLAIM path only, checking the base group build-products. Remaining: gate the pipeline/capability/API execution paths and map each action to its specific feature group (so e.g. a content action requires content-media), keeping fail-closed. -> Entitlement enforcement: cover remaining boundaries (pipeline/capability/API) + action->group mapping (beyond the worker-claim wired by A2)
